estimator.name: utf8-byte4-v1
estimator.definition: ceil(UTF-8 bytes / 4) per unique repository source, summed after de-duplication
estimator.material_saving_rule: pre_estimate - post_estimate must exceed pre_uncertainty + post_uncertainty

process_envelope.scope: Repository-owned mandatory initial_reads selected by the accepted profile. Live GitHub state, PR diff bytes and other per-candidate dynamic sources remain mandatory but are held outside this corpus budget because CTX does not control their size.

worker.rationale: Exact final-shape CTX-03 calibration on workflow run 35703773432; ceiling is ceil(19028 * 1.20).

repair_worker.rationale: Repository-owned initial reads calibrate to 19028; exact FAIL/PR/evidence remain dynamic mandatory inputs outside the static corpus budget.

reviewer.rationale: Repository-owned initial reads calibrate to 19028; candidate diff/live PR remain dynamic mandatory inputs outside the static corpus budget.

planner_gate.rationale: Final-shape planner starting pack calibrates to 19955 after accepted-closure history moved out of current ROADMAP; ceiling is ceil(19955 * 1.20).

docsync.rationale: Repository-owned DocSync starting sources calibrate to 8594; accepted PR/review/merge data remains dynamic and mandatory.

h1_local_executor.rationale: The narrow local-executor repository corpus calibrates to 6311; external anchor/manifest/named-file inputs remain dynamic and mandatory.

same_snapshot_measurement.snapshot_contract: All pre/post file bytes are read from the same checked-out candidate snapshot. Pre-CTX routing is reconstructed from checker-owned canonical representative direct-predecessor sources, not from the compact artifacts being measured. Post-CTX routing is the accepted canonical role profile plus validated capsule navigation. Sources that remain binding in both designs are held constant. Dynamic live GitHub/diff inputs are mandatory but excluded from the delta.
